title: Hook detail and deletion endpoints (GET/DELETE /api/hooks/{id})
user_story: As a user, I need to inspect a single hook's details and delete hooks I no longer need, so I can manage my webhook inboxes.
description: Implement two endpoints: GET /api/hooks/{id} returns full hook details as JSON, and DELETE /api/hooks/{id} removes the hook and all its captured requests via SQL CASCADE. A new database method delete_hook() is needed. The GET response includes hook_id, name, created_at, request_count, and url. The DELETE response is 200 with a confirmation message. Both return 404 for nonexistent hooks.

acceptance_criteria.then: response is 200 with JSON containing hook_id, name, created_at, request_count, and url
response is 404 with structured JSON error and suggestion

acceptance_criteria.given: a hook exists with hook_id 'abc123' and 5 captured requests
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 200 with confirmation, the hook is removed, and all 5 requests are CASCADE-deleted
response is 404 with structured JSON error and suggestion
the deleted hook no longer appears in the list
integration tests verify GET detail, DELETE, 404s, and CASCADE behavior
